limitations: If the original YAML still contains strategy.id=from_source, this change can recover the marker and block title delivery. If an earlier lossy parse was resaved with custom or a prior strategy id and no original YAML remains, provenance is gone. This change does not guess from name content or rewrite those documents.

This remains the existing small parser for the repository's two producer formats, not a new complete YAML parser or arbitrary handwritten YAML importer. No new dependency, durable provenance schema, title keyword denylist, broad form renaming or code-body sanitization was added.
Model exploitation and live endpoint behavior were not tested; evidence establishes local serialization and stale-response boundaries.
